# OECD venture capital investments (market statistics), by stage

Venture capital invested in companies located in each country (market statistics), by stage (seed, start-up and other early stage, later stage, total), in US dollars and as a percentage of GDP. European figures come from Invest Europe.

## Pinned identity

Retrieved on 24 November 2026. The consumer checks each response against the SHA-256 below and stops if the publisher has revised it.

| File | Dataflow | Bytes | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `venture_capital.csv` | `DSD_VC@DF_VC_INV` | 496,642 | `7e9ec1ba4dd91db54b72b2ba752c1b7cd8efc268587b29c7fea066c2be3810d9` |

Requests:

- `venture_capital.csv`: <https://sdmx.oecd.org/public/rest/data/OECD.SDD.TPS,DSD_VC@DF_VC_INV,1.0/all?format=csvfile>

The OECD endpoint refuses Python's default user-agent string; the consumer sends its own.
